title: Decomposing a finite-indexed function
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a type $\alpha$, a function from $\{0,\ldots,n\}$ to $\alpha$ is equivalent to a pair consisting of its value at $0$ and its restriction to the remaining $n$ indices.
